title: Principal Cone Small Site Criterion
statement: On a small ringed site, assume the displayed derived categories globally, on slices and on strict countable towers, and exact countable products. For any compatible global section a and its scalar chain endomorphism μ on P, Q of the principal cone completion is principally locally complete for a. Moreover Q(P) is principally locally complete if and only if the specified principal cone completion unit becomes an isomorphism. Dependencies: [def-pur-principal-cone-tower], [def-pur-ringed-principal-local-tests].

proof.text: the image ideal of scalar multiplication has precisely the locally divisible sections. Apply the singleton Koszul completion reflector to this image ideal, whose one-element generating list follows from the image factorization. The comparison with the strict tensor Koszul Roos complex and then the principal cone Roos complex preserves the degree-zero unit. Transport output completeness across these comparisons. Their unit equality identifies the reflector's invertibility criterion with the stated one.

lean.statement:
theorem principalConeSmallSiteCriterion
    (a : (R.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (P : CochainComplex A ℤ) (μ : End P)
    (hμ : ∀ (q : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X q).val.obj U),
      (μ.f q).val.app U x = @SMul.smul _ _ ((P.X q).val.obj U).isModule.toSMul (a.val U) x) :
    principalLocallyComplete.{u, u, u, w} R a
        ((DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := A)).obj (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.completion μ)) ∧
      (principalLocallyComplete.{u, u, u, w} R a ((DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := A)).obj P) ↔
        IsIso ((DerivedCategory.Q.{w} (C := A)).map (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.unit μ)))
